nodes.label: Step 6 Pre-Code Red-Team & Security Audit
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.rationale: Pauses before code to run business-analyst and security-auditor checks directly against the SDLC Master Plan without ceremony or separate memos.

nodes.label: Step 7 Project Skeletons & Local Environment
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.rationale: Initializes Git, lean AGENTS.md, portable /.agent/skills/, PostgreSQL docker-compose, and runnable backend/web/mobile project skeletons.

nodes.label: Appointment & Queue API Contract (/api/appointments)
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.rationale: Handles booking creation (with 409 Conflict guard), chronological daily queue listing (/me), and state transitions (/start, /complete, /cancel).

nodes.label: PostgreSQL appointments Table & idx_unique_active_slot
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.rationale: Tracks bookings across CONFIRMED, IN_PROGRESS, CANCELLED, COMPLETED with @Version optimistic locking and partial unique index idx_unique_active_slot preventing double-booking.

nodes.label: Authentication API Contract (/api/auth/register, /login, /me)
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.rationale: Issues 24h stateless JWT access tokens carrying userId, email, fullName, and role claims.

nodes.label: Shared Design System & Color Tokens
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.rationale: Defines Slate 900 Primary, Slate 50 Surface, Emerald 600 Confirmed, Amber 600 Pending/Queue, Rose 600 Cancelled/Error, Slate 600 Completed, and 8px/12px radii.

nodes.label: Docker Compose & Nginx Orchestration Architecture
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.rationale: Unites Nginx reverse proxy (port 443), Next.js standalone web app (port 3000), Spring Boot 3.x API (port 8080), and localhost-isolated PostgreSQL 16 (port 5432).

nodes.label: Standard Error Envelope (@RestControllerAdvice)
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.rationale: Unified sanitized JSON error structure (timestamp, status, error, message, path, fieldErrors) for 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, and 500 responses.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL provider_schedules Table
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.rationale: Enforces one continuous weekly shift per day_of_week (1..7) with unq_provider_day and slot_duration_minutes in (15, 30, 60).

nodes.label: Provider & Availability API Contract (/api/providers)
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.rationale: Exposes provider search, weekly schedule retrieval/atomic update, and date-based available slot calculation.

nodes.label: SlotCalculationService Dynamic Slot Engine
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.rationale: Computes bookable uniform time slots dynamically using provider IANA timezone cutoffs, weekly recurring shifts, and active CONFIRMED/IN_PROGRESS exclusions.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL users Table (PROVIDER / CLIENT & IANA Timezone)
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.norm_label: postgresql users table (provider / client & iana timezone)
nodes.rationale: Stores UUID, email, BCrypt password_hash, full_name, role (PROVIDER|CLIENT), and explicit IANA timezone (default UTC).

nodes.label: Business Analyst Skill (Red-Team Spec Auditor)
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.rationale: Zero-ceremony red-team spec auditor that attacks state machines, timezone/math boundaries, cross-entity mutations, concurrency, and schema-to-API-to-UI parity.

nodes.label: Flutter BLoC Clean Architecture Skill (Flutter 3.x)
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.rationale: Enforces feature-first Clean/BLoC structure, Dio auth interceptors, flutter_secure_storage token persistence, 48x48dp tap targets, and 409 Conflict auto-refresh.

nodes.label: Next.js App Router Skill (TypeScript & Tailwind)
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.rationale: Enforces Server vs. Client Component separation, HTTP-only cookie Route Handlers, role-aware middleware.ts guards, and Loading/Empty/Error/409 Conflict UI states.

nodes.label: Security Auditor Skill (6 Catastrophic Red Lines)
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.norm_label: security auditor skill (6 catastrophic red lines)
nodes.rationale: Enforces zero hardcoded secrets/fail-fast JWT_SECRET, anti-IDOR ownership checks, actuator lockdown & BCrypt DoS bounds, Next.js BFF HttpOnly cookie-to-Bearer pattern, error sanitization, and DB port isolation.

nodes.label: Spring Boot Architecture Skill (Java 21+ / Spring Boot 3.x)
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.norm_label: spring boot architecture skill (java 21+ / spring boot 3.x)
nodes.rationale: Enforces strict controller/service/repository/entity/dto/exception/security package boundaries, immutable record DTOs, Flyway migrations, and JUnit/Testcontainers verification.

nodes.label: Tech Lead Skill (Milestone Executor & Orchestrator)
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.rationale: Executes locked SDLC Master Plan milestones in dependency order (Infra -> Backend -> Web/Mobile) with 1-layer delegation and deterministic Creator-Verifier checks.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md Root AI Governance & Monorepo Router
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.norm_label: agents.md root ai governance & monorepo router
nodes.rationale: Separates project-specific Single Source of Truth (sdlc-master-plan.md) from generic blueprint (full-stack-project-playbook.md) and routes stack tasks to portable skills.

nodes.label: Full-Stack Project Execution Playbook
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.rationale: Generic, project-agnostic 13-step meta-workflow template for taking full-stack systems from product vision to containerized production deployment.

nodes.label: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.norm_label: sdlc master plan: appointment & queue booking system
nodes.rationale: Project-specific Single Source of Truth defining functional requirements, PostgreSQL schema, locked REST DTO contracts, design tokens, and execution milestones.

nodes.label: Anti-IDOR Principal Extraction & Ownership Rule
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.rationale: Never trusts client-supplied actor IDs in request bodies; extracts identity from JWT SecurityContext and verifies resource ownership before mutation.

nodes.label: Next.js BFF HttpOnly Cookie-to-Bearer Pattern
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.rationale: Stores JWTs in HttpOnly cookies on Next.js and forwards Authorization: Bearer <jwt> server-side so Spring Boot stays 100% stateless with zero CSRF surface.

nodes.label: Contract-First Execution Rule
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.rationale: Requires verifying locked schema, API endpoints, DTO payloads, error envelope, and design tokens in docs/sdlc-master-plan.md before modifying backend, web, or mobile.

nodes.label: 100% Project-Agnostic Skill Portability Rule
nodes.community_name: SDLC Master Plan: Appointment & Queue Booking System
nodes.rationale: Ensures all SKILL.md files under /.agent/skills/ remain free of project-specific domain terms so they can be reused across repositories unchanged.
